premise: On the hottest day Hermit Crab finds the umbrella's cool shade all to himself, then scoots over for Sandpiper, and then for Crab, and the shade is big enough for everyone.
inspiration: The mitten folk tale (Ukrainian: one more animal squeezes in), turned toward the giver: the first one there chooses to make room.
lesson: There's usually room for one more.

en-US.title: Shade for Everyone
en-US.text: {umbrella:enter} {canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s} It was the hottest day of the summer. {hermit-crab:enter} Hermit was so hot {hermit-crab:live hide hold} he hid right inside his shell. [sighs] Phew. Then he peeked out… {hermit-crab:live hide resume} and saw the umbrella, red and white, with a cool patch of shade underneath. {hermit-crab:go under umbrella} {hermit-crab:face happy} Ahh. Lovely. [short pause] {sandpiper:enter by run} Along ran Sandpiper, {sandpiper:face sad} panting. Hot, hot, hot! Hermit looked at the shade. It was HIS shade. He had found it first. {hermit-crab:face sad} Then he scooted over. {hermit-crab:face happy} [warmly] There's room for two, he said. {sandpiper:go under umbrella by run} {sandpiper:face happy} {crab:enter} Then Crab came scuttling by, red and hot. {hermit-crab:live wave} Room for three! said Hermit. {crab:go under umbrella} [happily] {umbrella:live spin} A little breeze came, and the umbrella turned round, fanning them all. {hermit-crab:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] And the shade, somehow, was big enough for everyone.

es-ES.title: Sombra para todos
es-ES.text: {umbrella:enter} {canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s} Era el día más caluroso del verano. {hermit-crab:enter} Cangrejo Ermitaño tenía tanto calor {hermit-crab:live hide hold} que se metió del todo en su concha. [sighs] Uf. Luego se asomó… {hermit-crab:live hide resume} y vio la sombrilla, roja y blanca, con una sombra fresquita debajo. {hermit-crab:go under umbrella} {hermit-crab:face happy} Aaah. Qué gusto. [short pause] {sandpiper:enter by run} Llegó corriendo Correlimos, {sandpiper:face sad} jadeando. ¡Qué calor, qué calor! Ermitaño miró la sombra. Era SU sombra. Él la había encontrado primero. {hermit-crab:face sad} Luego se hizo a un lado. {hermit-crab:face happy} [warmly] Aquí cabemos dos, dijo. {sandpiper:go under umbrella by run} {sandpiper:face happy} {crab:enter} Después pasó Cangrejo correteando, rojo y acalorado. {hermit-crab:live wave} ¡Cabemos tres!, dijo Ermitaño. {crab:go under umbrella} [happily] {umbrella:live spin} Llegó una brisita, y la sombrilla dio vueltas, abanicándolos a todos. {hermit-crab:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Y la sombra, no se sabe cómo, alcanzó para todos.

ja-JP.title: みんなの ひかげ
ja-JP.text: {umbrella:enter}{canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s}なつでいちばん、あつい日のことです。{hermit-crab:enter}ヤドカリくんは、あんまりあつくて、{hermit-crab:live hide hold}かいがらのなかに、すっぽり。[sighs]ふう。それから、{hermit-crab:live hide resume}ひょっこり顔を出すと…赤と白のビーチパラソル。その下には、すずしいひかげ。{hermit-crab:go under umbrella}{hermit-crab:face happy}ああ、いいきもち。[short pause]{sandpiper:enter by run}シギくんが、はしってきました。{sandpiper:face sad}はあ、はあ。あつい、あつい、あつーい！ヤドカリくんは、ひかげを見ました。ぼくのひかげだ。ぼくが、さきに見つけたんだもん。{hermit-crab:face sad}…それから、ちょこっと、よこへずれました。{hermit-crab:face happy}[warmly]「ふたり、はいれるよ」 {sandpiper:go under umbrella by run}{sandpiper:face happy}{crab:enter}つぎに、カニくんが、まっかっかで、カサカサやってきました。{hermit-crab:live wave}「三人、はいれるよ！」 とヤドカリくん。{crab:go under umbrella}[happily]{umbrella:live spin}そよかぜで、パラソルがくるりとまわって、みんなをそよそよ。{hermit-crab:hearts}{sandpiper:hearts}[softly]ひかげは、ふしぎと、みんながはいれる大きさでした。

de-DE.title: Schatten für alle
de-DE.text: {umbrella:enter} {canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s} Es war der heißeste Tag des ganzen Sommers. {hermit-crab:enter} Dem Einsiedlerkrebs war so heiß, {hermit-crab:live hide hold} dass er sich ganz in sein Häuschen verkroch. [sighs] Puh. Dann guckte er heraus… {hermit-crab:live hide resume} und sah den Sonnenschirm, rot und weiß, mit einem kühlen Fleckchen Schatten darunter. {hermit-crab:go under umbrella} {hermit-crab:face happy} Aaah. Herrlich. [short pause] Da kam {sandpiper:enter by run} der Strandläufer angerannt, {sandpiper:face sad} ganz außer Atem. „Heiß, heiß, heiß!“ Der Einsiedlerkrebs schaute auf den Schatten. Das war SEIN Schatten. Er hatte ihn zuerst gefunden. {hermit-crab:face sad} Dann rückte er ein Stück zur Seite. {hermit-crab:face happy} [warmly] „Hier ist Platz für zwei“, sagte er. {sandpiper:go under umbrella by run} {sandpiper:face happy} Gleich darauf kam {crab:enter} die Krabbe vorbeigekrabbelt, rot und ganz erhitzt. {hermit-crab:live wave} „Platz für drei!“, rief der Einsiedlerkrebs. {crab:go under umbrella} [happily] {umbrella:live spin} Ein kleines Lüftchen kam, und der Sonnenschirm drehte sich und fächelte allen kühle Luft zu. {hermit-crab:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Und der Schatten war irgendwie groß genug für alle.

fr-FR.title: De l’ombre pour tout le monde
fr-FR.text: {umbrella:enter} {canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s} C’était le jour le plus chaud de tout l’été. {hermit-crab:enter} Bernard-l’ermite avait tellement chaud {hermit-crab:live hide hold} qu’il s’est caché tout au fond de sa coquille. [sighs] Pfiou. Puis il a pointé le bout de son nez… {hermit-crab:live hide resume} et il a vu le parasol, rouge et blanc, avec un coin d’ombre tout frais dessous. {hermit-crab:go under umbrella} {hermit-crab:face happy} Ahhh. Que c’est bon. [short pause] {sandpiper:enter by run} Bécasseau est arrivé en courant, {sandpiper:face sad} tout essoufflé. Il faisait chaud, chaud, chaud ! Bernard-l’ermite a regardé l’ombre. C’était SON ombre. C’est lui qui l’avait trouvée le premier. {hermit-crab:face sad} Puis il s’est poussé un peu. {hermit-crab:face happy} [warmly] « Il y a de la place pour deux », a-t-il dit. {sandpiper:go under umbrella by run} {sandpiper:face happy} {crab:enter} Ensuite, Crabe est passé en trottinant, tout rouge et tout chaud. {hermit-crab:live wave} « Il y a de la place pour trois ! » a dit Bernard-l’ermite. {crab:go under umbrella} [happily] {umbrella:live spin} Une petite brise s’est levée, et le parasol a tourné, en les éventant tous. {hermit-crab:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Et l’ombre, on ne sait pas trop comment, était assez grande pour tout le monde.

it-IT.title: Ombra per tutti
it-IT.text: {umbrella:enter} {canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s} Era il giorno più caldo dell'estate. {hermit-crab:enter} Paguro aveva così caldo {hermit-crab:live hide hold} che si è rintanato tutto nella sua conchiglia. [sighs] Uff. Poi ha sbirciato fuori… {hermit-crab:live hide resume} e ha visto l'ombrellone, bianco e rosso, con sotto un'ombra bella fresca. {hermit-crab:go under umbrella} {hermit-crab:face happy} Aaah. Che meraviglia. [short pause] {sandpiper:enter by run} È arrivato di corsa Piovanello, {sandpiper:face sad} col fiatone. Che caldo, che caldo, che caldo! Paguro ha guardato l'ombra. Era la SUA ombra. L'aveva trovata lui per primo. {hermit-crab:face sad} Ma poi si è fatto un po' più in là. {hermit-crab:face happy} [warmly] «C'è posto per due», ha detto. {sandpiper:go under umbrella by run} {sandpiper:face happy} {crab:enter} Dopo un po' è passato Granchio, di corsa e di lato, rosso e accaldato. {hermit-crab:live wave} «C'è posto per tre!», ha detto Paguro. {crab:go under umbrella} [happily] {umbrella:live spin} È arrivata una brezzolina, e l'ombrellone si è messo a girare, come un ventaglio per tutti quanti. {hermit-crab:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] E l'ombra, chissà come, è bastata per tutti.

zh-TW.title: 大家一起乘涼
zh-TW.text: {umbrella:enter}{canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s}這是夏天最熱最熱的一天。{hermit-crab:enter}寄居蟹熱得受不了，{hermit-crab:live hide hold}整個縮進殼裡。[sighs]呼——好熱。過了一會兒，牠探出頭來……{hermit-crab:live hide resume}看見了遮陽傘，紅白條紋的，底下有一片涼涼的影子。{hermit-crab:go under umbrella}{hermit-crab:face happy}啊——好舒服。[short pause]{sandpiper:enter by run}濱鷸跑過來了，{sandpiper:face sad}喘吁吁的：「好熱、好熱、好熱！」 寄居蟹看看那片陰涼。那是牠自己的陰涼呀，是牠先找到的呢。{hermit-crab:face sad}可是，牠還是往旁邊挪了挪。{hermit-crab:face happy}[warmly]「這裡，兩個也坐得下喔。」 牠說。{sandpiper:go under umbrella by run}{sandpiper:face happy}{crab:enter}接著，螃蟹橫著走過來，紅通通的，熱呼呼的。{hermit-crab:live wave}「三個也坐得下！」 寄居蟹說。{crab:go under umbrella}[happily]{umbrella:live spin}涼涼的小風輕輕飄過來，遮陽傘轉呀轉，幫大家搧搧風。{hermit-crab:hearts}{sandpiper:hearts}[softly]說也奇怪，那片小小的陰涼，剛好大家都坐得下。

zh-HK.title: 大家一齊遮蔭
zh-HK.text: {umbrella:enter}{canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s}這是整個夏天最熱的一天。{hermit-crab:enter}寄居蟹熱得{hermit-crab:live hide hold}整個縮進了殼裏。[sighs]呼——好熱。然後，牠探出頭來……{hermit-crab:live hide resume}看見了紅白色的太陽傘，傘下有一片涼涼的陰影。{hermit-crab:go under umbrella}{hermit-crab:face happy}啊——真舒服。[short pause]{sandpiper:enter by run}濱鷸跑了過來，{sandpiper:face sad}喘着氣：「好熱，好熱，好熱呀！」 寄居蟹望着那片陰影。那是牠的陰影呀——是牠先找到的。{hermit-crab:face sad}牠想了想……然後，挪開了一點。{hermit-crab:face happy}[warmly]「夠位坐兩個㗎，」 牠說。{sandpiper:go under umbrella by run}{sandpiper:face happy}{crab:enter}跟着，螃蟹也打橫走過來，熱得紅彤彤的。{hermit-crab:live wave}「夠位坐三個！」 寄居蟹說。{crab:go under umbrella}[happily]{umbrella:live spin}來了一陣涼風，太陽傘轉呀轉，好像一把大扇子，替大家撥涼。{hermit-crab:hearts}{sandpiper:hearts}[softly]不知為甚麼，那片小小的陰影，剛好夠大家一起乘涼。

breeze.prompt: a soft warm summer breeze and fabric gently flapping, realistic
